modules.name: tb_down2_full_tensor
modules.description: Portless complete down2 testbench, not a deployable controller.

reset.name: rstn
reset.values: Invalidate old work and reload 1024 table entries.

behavior: Run 576 down2 tiles; compare each arithmetic stage and actual export.
constraints: TEST coefficients only; no DDR, board, synthesis or bitstream.
corner_cases: Partial halo cannot start; long output backpressure holds data.
verification_cases: Whole tensor, address uniqueness and coverage, top/left padding, right/bottom legal samples.

timing_diagrams.title: Complete halo then run
timing_diagrams.description: Compressed interval, not literal kernel latency.
